short: Decentralized non-custodial lending and borrowing protocol with multi-chain support
introduction: Aave V3 is one of the most widely used decentralized lending protocols in DeFi. It allows users to supply crypto assets to earn interest and borrow against their collateral without intermediaries. Aave V3 introduced efficiency mode (eMode), isolation mode, and portals for cross-chain liquidity, significantly improving capital efficiency over previous versions.
designPurpose: Aave V3 was designed to create an open, permissionless lending market where interest rates are determined algorithmically based on supply and demand. Its architecture enables risk-isolated markets, gas-optimized operations, and cross-chain asset bridging. The protocol uses overcollateralization and liquidation mechanisms to maintain solvency at all times.
commonUsage: Users commonly supply assets like ETH or stablecoins to earn passive yield, borrow stablecoins against volatile collateral for leveraged positions, and use flash loans for arbitrage or liquidations. Aave V3 is also widely integrated as a building block in other DeFi protocols for yield optimization and structured products.
fn.supply.desc: Deposits an asset into the Aave pool on behalf of a user, minting corresponding aTokens that accrue interest over time.
fn.supply.params.asset: The address of the ERC-20 token to supply to the pool.
fn.supply.params.amount: The amount of the asset to supply, in the token's native decimals.
fn.supply.params.onBehalfOf: The address that will receive the aTokens. Use msg.sender to supply for yourself.
fn.supply.params.referralCode: A referral code for tracking integrations. Use 0 if not applicable.
fn.borrow.desc: Borrows an asset from the Aave pool against existing collateral, minting debt tokens to track the obligation.
fn.borrow.params.asset: The address of the ERC-20 token to borrow from the pool.
fn.borrow.params.amount: The amount of the asset to borrow, in the token's native decimals.
fn.borrow.params.interestRateMode: The interest rate mode: 1 for stable rate, 2 for variable rate.
fn.borrow.params.referralCode: A referral code for tracking integrations. Use 0 if not applicable.
fn.borrow.params.onBehalfOf: The address that will incur the debt. Must have sufficient collateral deposited.
fn.repay.desc: Repays a borrowed asset, burning the corresponding debt tokens. Pass uint256 max to repay the entire outstanding debt.
fn.repay.params.asset: The address of the ERC-20 token being repaid.
fn.repay.params.amount: The amount to repay. Use type(uint256).max to repay the full debt.
fn.repay.params.interestRateMode: The interest rate mode of the debt: 1 for stable, 2 for variable.
fn.repay.params.onBehalfOf: The address of the user whose debt is being repaid.
fn.repay.returns.paybackAmount: The actual amount repaid, which may differ from the input if the debt was less.
fn.withdraw.desc: Withdraws a supplied asset from the pool by burning the corresponding aTokens and transferring the underlying to the recipient.
fn.withdraw.params.asset: The address of the underlying ERC-20 token to withdraw.
fn.withdraw.params.amount: The amount to withdraw. Use type(uint256).max to withdraw the full balance.
fn.withdraw.params.to: The address that will receive the withdrawn tokens.
fn.withdraw.returns.amountWithdrawn: The actual amount of underlying tokens withdrawn.
fn.liquidationCall.desc: Liquidates an undercollateralized position by repaying part of the borrower's debt and seizing discounted collateral as a reward.
fn.liquidationCall.params.collateralAsse: The address of the collateral token to seize from the borrower.
fn.liquidationCall.params.debtAsset: The address of the debt token to repay on behalf of the borrower.
fn.liquidationCall.params.user: The address of the borrower whose position is being liquidated.
fn.liquidationCall.params.debtToCover: The amount of debt to repay. Use type(uint256).max to repay the maximum allowed.
fn.liquidationCall.params.receiveAToken: If true, receive aTokens instead of the underlying collateral asset.
fn.flashLoan.desc: Executes a flash loan, lending one or more assets within a single transaction. The borrower must return the assets plus a premium by the end of the transaction.
fn.flashLoan.params.receiverAddress: The contract that will receive the flash-loaned assets and must implement IFlashLoanReceiver.
fn.flashLoan.params.assets: An array of token addresses to flash borrow.
fn.flashLoan.params.amounts: An array of amounts to flash borrow for each corresponding asset.
fn.flashLoan.params.interestRateModes: An array of rate modes for each asset. Use 0 for no debt (must repay), 1 for stable, 2 for variable.
fn.flashLoan.params.onBehalfOf: The address that will incur the debt if interestRateModes is non-zero.
fn.flashLoan.params.params: Arbitrary bytes data passed to the receiver's executeOperation callback.
fn.flashLoan.params.referralCode: A referral code for tracking integrations. Use 0 if not applicable.
fn.getUserAccountData.desc: Returns the aggregated account data for a user, including total collateral, total debt, borrowing power, and health factor.
fn.getUserAccountData.params.user: The address of the user to query.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.totalColla: The total collateral value in the base currency of the protocol.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.totalDebtB: The total outstanding debt in the base currency.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.availableB: The remaining borrowing capacity in the base currency.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.currentLiq: The weighted-average liquidation threshold across all collateral assets.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.ltv: The weighted-average loan-to-value ratio across all collateral assets.
fn.getUserAccountData.returns.healthFact: The health factor of the account. Below 1.0 means the position can be liquidated.
sim.supplyAndBorrow.name: Supply & Borrow
sim.supplyAndBorrow.desc: Simulates a user supplying ETH as collateral and then borrowing USDC against it, demonstrating the core lending/borrowing flow.
sim.supplyAndBorrow.step.supply: User calls supply() to deposit WETH into the Aave Pool. The pool transfers tokens and updates the reserve liquidity index.
sim.supplyAndBorrow.step.mintAToken: The pool mints aWETH tokens to the depositor, representing their interest-bearing deposit position.
sim.supplyAndBorrow.step.checkCollateral: The pool queries the oracle for the ETH price and calculates the health factor to verify sufficient collateral for borrowing.
sim.supplyAndBorrow.step.borrow: User calls borrow() to take out a USDC loan. The pool mints variableDebtUSDC tokens and transfers USDC to the borrower.
sim.liquidation.name: Liquidation
sim.liquidation.desc: Simulates a liquidation triggered by a price crash that drops the borrower's health factor below 1, allowing a liquidator to seize collateral at a discount.
sim.liquidation.step.healthFactorDrop: The oracle reports a sharp ETH price drop, causing the borrower's health factor to fall below 1.0, making the position eligible for liquidation.
sim.liquidation.step.liquidationCall: A liquidator calls liquidationCall(), repaying part of the borrower's USDC debt. The corresponding variableDebtUSDC is burned.
sim.liquidation.step.collateralSeized: The liquidator receives the borrower's WETH collateral plus a 5% liquidation bonus as a reward for maintaining protocol solvency.
compose.erc20.role: aTokens are deposit receipts implementing all EIP-20 methods with balances that grow as interest accrues, while variable debt tokens are ERC-20 variants whose transfer and approve are disabled.
compose.erc2612.role: aTokens implement EIP-2612 permit, letting users grant allowances with a signed message for gasless, single-transaction flows.
